purpose: Per-state Route Log mileage the build replaces, each with the figure FHWA publishes and the evidence. The build fails if the published figure has changed, so a fix at source is noticed rather than overwritten.
source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, tables 1 and 2, retrieved 2026-10-11

groups.finding: Tennessee's mileage column is shifted by one row across both tables, in route order from I-69 to I-840: each route carries the next route's length. The cities column is not shifted. The shifted figures match the measured geometry route by route (I-155 15.94 against 16 measured, I-240 20.02 against 20, I-275 2.99 against 3, I-440 7.64 against 7), and I-75's published 142.23 plus its 19.60 mi on I-40 gives Wikipedia's 161.8. I-69's own Tennessee figure is not in the table, so it is withdrawn rather than guessed.
